topic: worker-hosted LLM automations replacing an n8n pipeline: automation registry, 3-tier model runtime, prompt intake, cron scheduling, and gated actions on a Cloudflare Worker

subtopics.scope: Versioned automation templates in D1 (jev_automations): stages, per-stage prompt and model route, tool_refs, trigger, gate profile; draft/deploy/activate lifecycle with single-active-per-name auto-pause, revalidation on activation, run-task stamping and audit events.

subtopics.scope: The stage engine (jev-engine.js): stage types tool (pipeline I/O, GET-only enforced at def validation AND runtime), llm (prompt interpolation, JSON-mode with repair plus one strict retry, fail-soft on unparseable), builtin, guard, propose_actions; how stages chain run context.

LLM JSON output repair retry structured output validation

subtopics.scope: Three-tier LLM routing on Workers AI: classify routes to llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8, draft to llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast, guard to llama-guard-3-8b, raw model pins allowed, neuron usage accounted onto the task, binding vs REST response shapes.

subtopics.scope: Untrusted prompt intake: POST /api/jev/tasks with payload.prompt up to 8000 chars, one 70b call proposes actions over the policy tool list, proposals pass the same validation and deterministic gate as caller-supplied actions, verbatim storage, delimiting, no URL interpolation.

AI agent proposed actions require human approval gate pattern

subtopics.scope: Cron scheduling on the worker: cron trigger every 5 minutes runs the scheduler tick, interval automations fire with compare-and-set on last_fired_at, per-interval idempotency keys on created tasks, lost tick acceptable vs double fire unacceptable.

distributed cron idempotency compare and set last fired deduplication

subtopics.scope: The deterministic action gate and policy evolution: propose_actions outputs enter the existing gate unchanged, LLM never authorizes, policy v4 adds web.fetch_public (GET-only, hosts *, credential-less, response-capped) and places.search, any-host read-only tool risk class reasoning.
